steps.instruction: The studio owner says: "Build the pricing module for our class bookings: src/pricing.mjs exporting price(classType) for 'flow', 'yin' and 'private' classes, at $18.50, $16 and $90. Rules for everything we build, now and later: all money is integer cents; a cancellation is refunded in full if it is at least 24 hours before the class starts, half from 24 hours down to 6 hours before, and nothing after that; members get 10% off every price, rounded down to the whole cent." Do what is asked now. A different session will build the next features.

Add src/refunds.mjs exporting refundFor(booking, cancelledAt), where booking is { classType, startsAt, member } and times are milliseconds since the epoch. It returns the refund for cancelling that booking at cancelledAt, following the studio's rules, and uses src/pricing.mjs.
